title: Envoy Gateway — Edge Overview
description: Edge SRE view of the local-stack Envoy Gateway: golden signals on the data plane (job=envoy, gateway:19005 /stats/prometheus), control-plane health (job=envoy-gateway, gateway:19001), and process-level infrastructure. Cluster-only panels are marked planned.

panels.title: README — how to read this dashboard

options.content:
**Control plane says** “traffic to `/payment` must go THERE, with THIS timeout and THIS TLS.” · **Data plane says** “OK — a `/payment` request just passed through me in 120 ms.” · **This dashboard says** “20k req/s, p99 is 1.2 s, and 5xx is rising.”

**What each row reads:** **Edge Overview** + **Data Plane** ← job `envoy` (Envoy proxy stats, gateway:19005 `/stats/prometheus`) · **Control Plane** ← job `envoy-gateway` (EG controller, gateway:19001) · **Infrastructure** ← process/server metrics from both jobs.

Panels titled **“(cluster — planned)”** read kube-state / cAdvisor / status-updater metrics that only exist on the Kubernetes cluster — they are empty locally **by design**; each carries a live local fallback query.

panels.title: Requests / sec (edge)
panels.description: Total downstream request rate on the edge traffic listener (conn managers http-*; admin/readiness/stats listeners excluded).

panels.title: Error rate (5xx)
panels.description: Share of completed edge responses in class 5xx. NaN with zero traffic.

panels.title: P99 latency (edge)
panels.description: 99th percentile downstream request time (Envoy buckets are milliseconds).

panels.title: Availability (dashboard window)
panels.description: 1 - (5xx / all responses) over the dashboard time range.

panels.title: Request rate by route (upstream cluster)
panels.description: Per-HTTPRoute upstream request rate. Cluster names are httproute/<ns>/<route>/rule/<n> as programmed by Envoy Gateway.

panels.title: 4xx / 5xx response rate (edge)
panels.description: Downstream responses in class 4xx and 5xx on the edge listener. Includes requests the edge rejects before any upstream/span exists (JWT 401, no route).

panels.title: Downstream latency p50 / p95 / p99 (edge)
panels.description: End-to-end downstream request time at the edge (includes upstream time).

panels.title: Upstream latency p95 by route
panels.description: Per-upstream-cluster request time p95 — the backend's share of edge latency.

panels.title: Upstream retries & timeouts
panels.description: Router retry/timeout counters across all HTTPRoute clusters. Sustained retries mean an unhealthy backend; timeouts count against the retry budget.

panels.title: Active connections
panels.description: Concurrent connections: downstream on the edge conn manager, the :8000 listener, and pooled upstream connections to route clusters.

panels.title: Watchable events / publishes by runner
panels.description: Reconcile activity of EG's watching components (provider, gateway-api, xds-translator, xds-server, infrastructure). Flat zero while config is idle is normal.

panels.title: Watchable subscribe duration p99 by runner
panels.description: How long each EG component holds a reconcile pass (subscribe callback).

panels.title: Watchable queue depth by runner
panels.description: Unprocessed watchable queue depth per component — sustained growth means the control plane is not keeping up with config churn.

panels.title: xDS snapshot creates / updates
panels.description: xDS snapshot cache activity. NOTE: only xds_snapshot_create_total is confirmed in local-stack; xds_snapshot_update_total (and xds_stream_duration_seconds) appear once snapshots update — query B may be empty.

panels.title: Gateway / HTTPRoute status updates
panels.description: status_update_total{kind} exists only where EG runs with the Kubernetes provider (cluster); local-stack Host mode emits none — query A stays empty locally. Working local fallback (query B): the provider's *-status watchable queue depths (0 = status work drained).

panels.title: Control-plane panics & cert watcher
panels.description: Any non-zero panic or cert-read error is actionable. watchable_panics_recovered_total is documented but only appears after a recovered panic — the `or vector(0)` keeps the series drawable.

panels.title: Control-plane CPU (EG process)
panels.description: CPU of the Envoy Gateway control-plane process (its own /metrics; no cAdvisor/container metrics exist in local-stack). 1.0 = one core.

panels.title: Memory — EG process & Envoy server
panels.description: Control-plane process RSS next to the Envoy server's own memory gauges (both halves share the gateway container).

panels.title: Edge health
panels.description: envoy_server_live/up: 1 is healthy. Uptime resets reveal silent restarts (the local stand-in for pod restart counts).

panels.title: Pod restarts / container CPU (kube-state + cAdvisor)
panels.description: kube-state-metrics / cAdvisor series exist only in the cluster — empty in local-stack by design (planned). Local fallback: Envoy uptime; a sawtooth means restarts.
